changes: Added Mameluke Sword achievement using supplied artwork.
Mameluke Sword unlocks after the player has achieved both Corporal and Second Lieutenant.
Added Good Conduct Medal achievement using supplied artwork.
Good Conduct Medal unlocks after 156 consecutive training weeks without a BMT recruit being recycled.
Added a visible cumulative training weeks counter beneath the MARINE MERGE heading.
Successful BMT contributes 13 weeks; Plebe Summer 8; MECEP/OCS 12; WOBC 16.
A recycled BMT recruit resets the clean-training streak but its 13 training weeks still count toward the cumulative total.
Special achievements use the same bottom-right achievement-unlock popup format.
